### Event Details

*   **Dates:** August 29 - 31, 2025
*   **Time:** 11 a.m. - 11 p.m. Daily
*   **Location:** Stanwix Street and Liberty Avenue in Downtown Pittsburgh
*   **Admission:** FREE

### Soul Food & Good Times

Indulge in a feast for the senses as soul food vendors serve up irresistible dishes. Witness pitmasters battle it out in the sizzling BBQ contest, explore rich cultural activities, and peruse unique crafts from talented vendors. As the aroma of soul food fills the air, visit the stages and dance the night away.

### 2025 Entertainment Schedule

Check back for more information about Soul Food Festival's music and entertainment lineup.

Plan Your Trip
--------------

Maximize your Soul Food Festival experience by exploring everything [Downtown Pittsburgh](https://www.visitpittsburgh.com/neighborhoods/downtown-pittsburgh/) has to offer. When [planning your visit](https://www.visitpittsburgh.com/plan-your-trip/), consider [booking your stay](https://www.visitpittsburgh.com/hotels-resorts/) at one of the many hotels near Market Square to be steps away from the festivities.
